method: FM3_SHOT_LOAD.py --load sends the generated preset to the edit buffer (7F 00) and reads the Multi Delay record (74) with fn=0x1F (read-only), word for word against the generated file; the user checks the FM3-Edit Type names without saving and listens to scenes 1..4. Nothing is stored or set.
meaning: A preset written through multidelayTypes (four Types on channels A..D, Mix on top of A) loads with every Multi Delay word as generated, FM3-Edit shows the four Type names and the channels sound like them. multidelayTypes is device-confirmed for load + edit buffer; STORE/reload was not done.
notMeasured: Types other than these four on the device through the generator (their images are the T35 reads)
